slice: MP4-BOX-002/AVI-CHUNK-001 exact proof slice (not the whole Issue)

environment.memory_measurement: /usr/bin/time -v wrapping each cargo kani invocation; not per-solver cgroup isolation

input_domain.mp4_box_002: full numeric domain of at:u64, limit:u64, size32:u32, largesize:u64; no input narrowing assume. at>limit is a production-unreachable total extension classified as truncated base header. largesize is an exact reparameterization and is unobserved unless size32==1
input_domain.avi_chunk_001: full numeric domain of offset:u64, region_len:u64, size:u32; no input narrowing assume. offset>region_len is a production-unreachable total extension classified as trailing bytes

assumptions.assumption: no input narrowing assume in either proof
one-step measure decrease may be composed mathematically with finite region length
assumptions.classification: human composition only; not machine-proved unbounded termination

coverage.mp4_exact_complement: Advance iff base header is available, form-specific size constraints hold, body end addition does not overflow, and end<=limit. Invalid is the exact complement split into truncated base/largesize header, size smaller than header, largesize smaller than 16, size overflow, and region overrun with production precedence
coverage.avi_exact_complement: End iff offset==region_len. TrailingBytes is the exact header-unavailable non-end complement. Advance iff header available, body end addition does not overflow, body end<=region_len, and pad-inclusive next offset<=region_len. Invalid is the exact header-available complement split into size overflow, body overrun, and missing pad with production precedence
coverage.scan_termination: single-step strict progress and measure decrease are machine-checked. finite/unbounded scan synthesis is not claimed

wav-chunk-scan.note: WAV proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented

wav-range.note: WAV proofs were not redesigned or reimplemented

connection_conditions.mp4: production box_header reads size32/largesize/tag and delegates boundary arithmetic to mp4_box_boundary_step. top-level scan and every nested child_boxes path use box_header. Internal enum maps to pre-existing MediaError::malformed strings
connection_conditions.avi: production Chunks::next uses avi_chunk_position/avi_chunk_step for RIFF body, hdrl, strl, and movi nested regions. Valid results drive body slice, pad-inclusive remainder, and next offset. Internal enum maps to pre-existing MediaError::malformed strings
connection_conditions.true_to_code: proofs invoke production helpers directly. No cfg(kani) replacement, fmt/alloc stub, Cursor, writer fixture, Vec decode, full parser, or diagnostic formatting is in the proof target
connection_conditions.public_contract: public API signatures, public error kinds/text, error precedence, supported formats, normal/error behavior, f64 precision, and partial ingest/capability semantics are unchanged
